description: This file defines the interface TemplateDAO which declares database operations related to message templates in the OpenMRS system, such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting Template objects.

classes.name: TemplateDAO
classes.description: Interface for database operations related to message templates in OpenMRS.

methods.name: getTemplates
methods.description: Retrieves all message templates from the database.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a message template by its internal identifier.

methods.name: getTemplatesByName
methods.description: Retrieves message templates matching a given name.

methods.name: createTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new message template in the database.
